York and western Pennsylvania. Serving since 1969, we are the go-to experts for installation,

## Our Elevator and Lift Solutions Designed Around Your Lifestyle

Operating since 1969, Access Elevator has helped families and businesses move safely between floors
with dependable elevator and lift solutions. As a local, family-owned installation and service
provider, our team combines decades of experience with modern mobility technology to design,
install, and maintain systems that improve accessibility, independence, and everyday convenience.
Check out our main solutions.

[Ascenda Elevator C2]

Access Elevator installs [residential][55] and [commercial systems][56], delivering home elevators
and lift products for custom layouts.

[Straight][58] and [curved lifts ][59]provide practical accessibility solutions for homes and
businesses, improving mobility, safety, and independence across multi-level spaces with ease.

### What qualifications make Access Elevator an expert in mobility solutions?

We are a New York State Registered Contractor, fully insured, and employs CET and CAT Certified
technicians. These credentials ensure safe, code-aligned installations for both residential and
commercial clients.

### What resources are available for architects and builders?

Our team [provides specifications][73], CAD drawings, and elevator code compliance support to assist
architects and builders with custom elevator design support and project coordination.

### What’s the difference between a home elevator and a stairlift?

A home elevator moves between floors inside a dedicated lift space, while a stairlift travels along
the staircase itself on a mounted rail. Access Elevator helps homeowners compare both options based
on mobility needs, available space, and long-term accessibility goals.

the elevator could be placed, they were patient with me while I went through all the customizing
options. My elevator has worked perfectly since it was installed and I would recommend Access

### What qualifications make Access Elevator an expert in mobility solutions?

We are a New York State Registered Contractor, fully insured, and employs CET and CAT Certified
technicians. These credentials ensure safe, code-aligned installations for both residential and

Our team [provides specifications][73], CAD drawings, and elevator code compliance support to assist
architects and builders with custom elevator design support and project coordination.

### What’s the difference between a home elevator and a stairlift?

A home elevator moves between floors inside a dedicated lift space, while a stairlift travels along
the staircase itself on a mounted rail. Access Elevator helps homeowners compare both options based
on mobility needs, available space, and long-term accessibility goals.

      The Schindler 3100 MRL elevator is a cost-effective, machine room-less traction elevator for
      two- to three-story buildings.
    * [Schindler 3300 low- to mid-rise][15]
      
      The Schindler 3300 MRL traction elevator for low- to mid-rise buildings is the ideal hydraulic
      elevator alternative.
    * [Schindler 5000 low- to mid-rise][16]
      
      From low- to mid-rise buildings, from standard to sophisticated—the Schindler 5000 MRL
      elevator is ideal for tomorrow’s offices, hotels, hospitals, apartment complexes, and more.
    * [Schindler 5500 mid-rise][17]
      
      The Schindler 5500 is a high-performance, gearless traction MRL elevator for mid-rise
      buildings. It offers glass and bare car options, too.
    * [Schindler 7000 high-rise][18]
      
      The Schindler 7000 traction elevator for high-rise buildings fits the needs of taller
      buildings with even more efficient and innovative mobility solutions.
    * [Schindler 330A hydraulic][19]
      
      The Schindler 330A holeless hydraulic elevator is the smarter, more efficient solution for a
      wide range of low-rise applications.

      Restore your elevator with our Schindler ReStore modernization solution, which replaces
      critical electrical components to upgrade the efficiency and performance of your equipment.

      controller, inverter, fixtures, and machine upgrade to ensure a smoother ride experience.

      boost performance, and improve aesthetics.
    * [Capital planning & financing][27]
      
      Let us help you develop a customized capital plan to upgrade and modernize your elevators over
      time.

## FAQ

What sets your company apart as one of the best elevator providers in Kerala?

advanced technology, energy efficiency, highest quality, and we prioritize safety while making the
installations. Our adherence to global standards sets us apart from our competitors.

What types of elevators do you specialize in?

Our elevator company in Kerala specialise in both Hydraulic elevators and Passenger elevators.

Do you offer installation services for both residential and commercial buildings?

Yes, as the best elevator company in Kerala, we have dedicated teams working on elevator
installations for both residential and commercial buildings. Our customer support team can also
arrange for after-sales support and maintenance solutions as well.

What is the typical timeline for elevator installation?

The typical timeline for elevator installation will be based on the project complexity, number of
elevators to be installed and the building type. For residential installations the average time
would be about 4-6 weeks, while for commercial projects the time period might be 8-12 weeks or
longer.

Are your elevators designed to meet Kerala's safety and building regulations?

Of course, we diligently follow Kerala’s safety and building regulations in all our projects, and
our supervisors will ensure that the installations. As the best elevator company in Kerala, we keep

solutions tailored to your specific needs. Our team of experts is dedicated to delivering safe,
reliable, and innovative vertical transportation systems that enhance your building’s functionality
and efficiency.

## FAQ

What sets your company apart as one of the best elevator providers in Kerala?

Our commitment as a premium elevator company in Kerala, enables us to provide the best in terms of
advanced technology, energy efficiency, highest quality, and we prioritize safety while making the
installations. Our adherence to global standards sets us apart from our competitors.

What types of elevators do you specialize in?

Our elevator company in Kerala specialise in both Hydraulic elevators and Passenger elevators.

Do you offer installation services for both residential and commercial buildings?

Yes, as the best elevator company in Kerala, we have dedicated teams working on elevator
installations for both residential and commercial buildings. Our customer support team can also
arrange for after-sales support and maintenance solutions as well.

What is the typical timeline for elevator installation?

The typical timeline for elevator installation will be based on the project complexity, number of
elevators to be installed and the building type. For residential installations the average time
would be about 4-6 weeks, while for commercial projects the time period might be 8-12 weeks or
longer.

Are your elevators designed to meet Kerala's safety and building regulations?

Of course, we diligently follow Kerala’s safety and building regulations in all our projects, and
our supervisors will ensure that the installations. As the best elevator company in Kerala, we keep
ourselves abreast of the latest standards in safety, fire resistance, and accessibility, and ensure
all this is meticulously followed in all our projects.

## من الشركة المناسبة إلى التواصل المباشر، في ثلاث خطوات

صُمِّم دليل تركيا ليوفّر وقتك — سواء كنت مقيماً تبحث عن خدمة موثوقة أو مشترياً يتعامل مع مصنعين أتراك.

01

### اكتشف شركات موثوقة

ابحث حسب التصنيف — خدمات حكومية، رعاية صحية، عقارات، دليل المصانع والمزيد — في جميع مدن تركيا.
* نتائج ثنائية اللغة بالعربية والإنكليزية
* فلترة حسب المدينة والقطاع والتقييم

02

### قارن بثقة

اقرأ التقييمات الحقيقية، اطّلع على ساعات العمل والصور والشهادات. شارات «موثَّق» و«مميّز» تساعدك على
تمييز الخيارات الأفضل.
* ملكية وبيانات تواصل موثَّقة
* تقييمات حقيقية من عملاء حقيقيين

03

### تواصل بنقرة واحدة

راسل أصحاب الشركات مباشرة عبر واتساب، أرسل طلب عرض سعر للموردين، أو زرهم شخصياً — بدون وسطاء، بدون
عراقيل.
* أزرار واتساب واتصال مباشرة
* أداة طلب عرض سعر لاستفسارات الأعمال

## من الشركة المناسبة إلى التواصل المباشر، في ثلاث خطوات

صُمِّم دليل تركيا ليوفّر وقتك — سواء كنت مقيماً تبحث عن خدمة موثوقة أو مشترياً يتعامل مع مصنعين أتراك.

01

### اكتشف شركات موثوقة

ابحث حسب التصنيف — خدمات حكومية، رعاية صحية، عقارات، دليل المصانع والمزيد — في جميع مدن تركيا.
* نتائج ثنائية اللغة بالعربية والإنكليزية
* فلترة حسب المدينة والقطاع والتقييم

02

### قارن بثقة

اقرأ التقييمات الحقيقية، اطّلع على ساعات العمل والصور والشهادات. شارات «موثَّق» و«مميّز» تساعدك على
تمييز الخيارات الأفضل.
* ملكية وبيانات تواصل موثَّقة
* تقييمات حقيقية من عملاء حقيقيين

03

### تواصل بنقرة واحدة

راسل أصحاب الشركات مباشرة عبر واتساب، أرسل طلب عرض سعر للموردين، أو زرهم شخصياً — بدون وسطاء، بدون
عراقيل.
* أزرار واتساب واتصال مباشرة
* أداة طلب عرض سعر لاستفسارات الأعمال

[تصفّح الدليل][28][أضف شركتك][29]

## من الشركة المناسبة إلى التواصل المباشر، في ثلاث خطوات

صُمِّم دليل تركيا ليوفّر وقتك — سواء كنت مقيماً تبحث عن خدمة موثوقة أو مشترياً يتعامل مع مصنعين أتراك.

01

### اكتشف شركات موثوقة

ابحث حسب التصنيف — خدمات حكومية، رعاية صحية، عقارات، دليل المصانع والمزيد — في جميع مدن تركيا.
* نتائج ثنائية اللغة بالعربية والإنكليزية
* فلترة حسب المدينة والقطاع والتقييم

02

### قارن بثقة

اقرأ التقييمات الحقيقية، اطّلع على ساعات العمل والصور والشهادات. شارات «موثَّق» و«مميّز» تساعدك على
تمييز الخيارات الأفضل.
* ملكية وبيانات تواصل موثَّقة
* تقييمات حقيقية من عملاء حقيقيين

03

### تواصل بنقرة واحدة

راسل أصحاب الشركات مباشرة عبر واتساب، أرسل طلب عرض سعر للموردين، أو زرهم شخصياً — بدون وسطاء، بدون
عراقيل.
* أزرار واتساب واتصال مباشرة
* أداة طلب عرض سعر لاستفسارات الأعمال

[تصفّح الدليل][28][أضف شركتك][29]

Pizzas in Mix 'N' Match Box are not customisable, vegan pizzas are not available.

ALLERGEN & DIETARY INFORMATION

Domino’s takes food allergies seriously. However, our stores handle a wide range of ingredients, and
multiple allergens are present in the store environment.

Due to shared preparation areas, equipment and normal store operations, cross-contact may occur,
this may result in the presence of unintentional traces of allergens, gluten, animal products and /
or meat.

As a result, we cannot guarantee that any product is completely gluten free or allergen free.

More details about Domino’s vegan, vegetarian, allergen and gluten-free products are available
online and can be accessed by scanning the allergen brochure and QR code in store.

Customers with allergies or specific dietary requirements should review the latest allergen
information online before placing an order.

Major Allergens Present in Store Include: Wheat, Tree nuts (pistachio, almond, hazelnut, Brazil nut,
cashew, macadamia, pecan, pine nut, walnut), Soy, Milk, Eggs, Sesame, Crustacea, Fish, Molluscs,
Peanuts, Sulphites and Lupin, and other allergens.

Customers can also contact the Domino’s Vocal Team AU for further information: Contact[ Us -

or lifestyle reasons. However, they may not be suitable for individuals with food allergies.

requested. However, traces of meat and/or dairy products may be unintentionally present due to
cross‑contact during normal store operations. As a result, we cannot guarantee that vegan or

### Frequently Asked Questions

What Are the Different Types of Elevators?

**There are three main types of elevators:**
* – Winding drum elevators.  These are most commonly used in home elevators.
  
  – Traction elevators.  These are used in newer commercial and home elevator applications.
  
  – Hydraulic elevators.  These are used in low-rise commercial applications.

What Is the Purpose of an Elevator?

Elevators and lifts are equipment used for vertical transportation that can move people and goods
between multiple floors of a house or business. They are especially beneficial for transporting
people who may not be able to use the stairs for a variety of different reasons or for easy moving
of heavy objects.

####  

How Do Home Elevators Work?

Home elevators can use many different mechanisms. One of the most common is the winding drum drive,
which uses a motor and drum to spool hoisting cable to raise the car.  Another common mechanism is a
roped hydraulic drive, which uses a hydraulic jack and a pulley system to raise and lower the car.

What Is the Difference Between a Lift and an Elevator?

An elevator has a cab that is usually completely enclosed and requires an elevator shaft, while a
lift often has an open cab save for small panels on the sides of the platform. Since lifts are
simpler in design, they tend to have a lower price point than elevators.

####  

Is There an Alternative to a Stair Lift?

If you need to travel between floors of a building but cannot use a stair lift, a wheelchair lift or
enclosed residential elevator is likely to be a better alternative for you.

####  

Which Elevator Is Best?

Which elevator is best will depend in part on your space and your mobility needs. But whether you
need a large commercial elevator to make your business accessible or a single-person pneumatic
elevator for your home to make going upstairs more convenient, you’ll want to shop top elevator
brands to find a high-quality product at a reasonable price.

####  

How Much Does an Elevator Cost?

On average, elevator installation companies usually charge between $35,000 and $50,000, but your
cost will depend on the size and style of the elevator you need and how many floors the elevator
needs to travel between.

####  

What Companies Make Elevators?

Many companies make elevators, but one of the top elevator manufacturers is Nationwide Lifts. We
build and sell a wide variety of innovative residential and commercial elevators in all styles and
sizes, and we sell them at affordable prices. The experience and skill level of our technicians far
surpasses what you’ll find at other elevator companies, and we’re constantly working to develop new
lift and elevator products to better serve you.

####  

How Often Should Elevators Be Serviced?

You should have your elevator system inspected at least once a year to make sure that it’s in good
working order and catch any small problems before they become large ones.

How Much Does an Elevator Cost?

On average, elevator installation companies usually charge between $35,000 and $50,000, but your
cost will depend on the size and style of the elevator you need and how many floors the elevator
needs to travel between.

####  

What Companies Make Elevators?

Many companies make elevators, but one of the top elevator manufacturers is Nationwide Lifts. We
build and sell a wide variety of innovative residential and commercial elevators in all styles and
sizes, and we sell them at affordable prices. The experience and skill level of our technicians far
surpasses what you’ll find at other elevator companies, and we’re constantly working to develop new
lift and elevator products to better serve you.

####  

How Often Should Elevators Be Serviced?

You should have your elevator system inspected at least once a year to make sure that it’s in good
working order and catch any small problems before they become large ones.

### About Us

Nationwide Lifts has the most complete and innovative product line in the industry. We strive to
develop new products and partnerships, giving homes and businesses exactly what they need. With our
network of offices and franchises, Nationwide Lifts is capable of fulfilling your elevator needs
anywhere in United States and Canada!

## General FAQs

# [What does non-proprietary mean for my elevator system?][55]

Non-proprietary means our controllers are designed with industry-standard components and open
documentation. This gives building owners the freedom to choose any qualified maintenance provider
rather than being locked into a specific manufacturer for parts or service tools.

# [Where are your controllers manufactured and shipped from? ][56]

All our systems are engineered and manufactured in Garden City, New York, USA. We maintain fully
stocked warehouses in Garden City, New York, and Sunrise, Florida, ensuring rapid lead times and
localized support for both the Northeast and Southeast regions.

# [Can your controllers be used for both new installations and modernizations? ][57]

Yes. Our ES1 and ES2 series (Traction and Hydraulic) are specifically designed for versatility. They
are ideal for upgrading aging equipment to modern standards or for integration into brand-new
construction projects.

## Technical & Compliance FAQs

# [How does ESI assist with Door Lock Monitoring (DLM) compliance? ][58]

We offer dedicated DLM solutions tailored to meet specific state mandates, including Florida and
Nevada requirements. Our systems are designed for easy integration with existing equipment to bring
older elevators up to code without requiring a full controller replacement.

# [What is the lead time for a custom controller order? ][59]

We take pride in having some of the fastest turnaround times in the industry. While lead times vary
by complexity, we have a proven track record—such as our recent Houston project—of delivering
custom-engineered hydraulic controllers in as little as two weeks from order confirmation.

# [Do your systems support remote monitoring and diagnostics? ][60]

Yes. Our EMIS-100 and [Lift-*i*][61] systems provide real-time remote monitoring, allowing for
proactive maintenance and faster troubleshooting, which significantly reduces equipment downtime.

## Support & Parts FAQs

# [How do I get technical support for an ESI controller in the field? ][62]

We provide comprehensive technical support via phone or text at 516-239-4044. Our engineering team
is available to assist technicians with installation, programming, and troubleshooting to ensure a
smooth project handover.

# [Can I buy individual replacement parts or boards directly? ][63]

Absolutely. We keep an extensive inventory of circuit boards, drives, digital position indicators,
load weighing equipment, and tape selector units in stock. You can email
[orders@elevatorsystems.com][64] for immediate availability and pricing.

# [Do you offer certification for Canadian or international markets?][65]

We are currently expanding our certification reach. Please contact our sales team to discuss
specific regional requirements, including CSA Group certifications for North American expansion.

###### 36 Years of Experience: ESCON Elevators is a top 5 elevator company in India, a leader in the
###### world for Automobile Elevator (Car Elevators) with a first-of-its-kind (FIFO Concept),
###### providing customized elevator solutions since 1990.

0+
Happy Customers

ESCON Elevators has grown from strength to strength with the help of its in-house facilities and
collaborations, to add other products to its stable. All products are launched only after thorough
test runs over long periods of time, meeting the most demanding conditions and situations.

This stringent quality policy of the company, along with its state-of-the-art infrastructure, has
earned it customers’ confidence and a competitive edge to secure berths in the final selections.
ESCON has received the ISO 9001-2015 certification for design, manufacturing, and quality assurance,
along with the safety standard as per IS 14665. The company has also received the NSIC CRISIL
performance rating- SE1B, which points to superior performance and stable financial strength. With a
continuous focus on technological advancements and customer satisfaction, ESCON is on the fast track
of growth and excellence.

**[MORE ABOUT US][40]**

###### Quick Links: [Elevators][41], [Escalators][42]
* [LinkedIn][43]
* [YouTube][44]
* [Instagram][45]
* [Facebook][46]

ESCON Elevators is a leading manufacturer of elevators & escalators, with 36 years of experience and
a long list of satisfied customers across the country and abroad. The manufacturing setup of ESCON
comprises of state of the art facilities in terms of Research & Development, Production, Testing,
and Quality assurance. Every installation of ESCON is backed by prompt and on-site maintenance
support from qualified and trained engineers.

Apart from new elevator installation, the company also specializes in modernization of existing and
old systems by providing consultancy services, technical audit & inspection, repair and replacement
of the worn-out parts, as well as technology up-gradation.

## Check Out The Live Videos

### **OUR SPECIALIZATION**

### **[ELEVATOR][47]**

We at ESCON Elevators are proud to cater to the mobility needs of various industries like hospitals,
pharmaceuticals, restaurants, residency, small elevators, etc. Our elevators are engineered for
energy efficiency, comfortable ride quality, easy controls, cost-effectiveness, as well as
innovative and flexible designs.

**[READ MORE][48]**

### **[ESCALATOR][49]**

ESCON manufactures Escalators and Autowalks used in both indoor and outdoor applications. Every
Escalator and autowalk is equipped with the latest technologies, enabling high power savings and
best-in-class safety features, which give surety of low noise, highest product life,
cost-effectiveness, and improved safety.

**[READ MORE][50]**

### **PARKING**

We at ESCON provide a world-class parking system for your elite infrastructure that meets our
clients’ specified requirements. Our delivery system runs on a smooth structure, and timely delivery
of our products is assured by us on all levels. With the rising demand for parking spaces in India,
we provide a complete solution.

**[READ MORE][51]**

#### Peak Passenger Flow Miscalculation Triggers Operational Risks

Elevator congestion in commercial complexes is often caused by deviations in passenger flow
forecasting and rigid dispatching strategies rather than equipment limitations. By shifting from
single-machine thinking to system management with dynamic scheduling and data monitoring, projects
can effectively balance peak pressure and improve operational efficiency.

04 2026 ,Mar

#### Optimization Strategies for Stage Raising Equipment Safety Management

Integrating stage elevators into the overall stage system and implementing systematic safety
management can significantly reduce accident risks and optimize performance operations. For theaters
planning or using lifting equipment, evaluating operation and maintenance at the system level is
essential to ensure safety and reliability.

25 2026 ,Feb

#### The Real Test Of Elevator System Safety Boundaries

When intelligent elevator systems fail, the real test lies in their safety boundaries and emergency
capability rather than operational efficiency. Prioritizing safety-first architecture with local
control and mechanical backups is essential for maintaining stability in extreme scenarios.

06 2026 ,Feb

#### Hidden Risks And Consequences In The Elevator Acceptance Phase

Elevator acceptance should be treated as a pre-operational system evaluation rather than a
procedural checkpoint, and combining professional assessment with simulated usage scenarios can
reduce operational risks and ensure smooth long-term operation.

30 2026 ,Jan

#### Hidden Risks In The Design Decision-making Of Household Elevators

As highlighted in the previous discussion, many post-installation issues of household elevators
originate from early-stage selection and design decisions rather than equipment defects. Returning
to system-level planning and lifecycle evaluation is essential to ensure real suitability for
long-term residential use.

22 2026 ,Jan

#### Freight Elevators As System Nodes In Logistics Parks

Freight elevators should be considered as critical nodes in logistics operations, and by
incorporating them into system-level planning and dynamic management, overall turnover efficiency
can be significantly improved. Effective system optimization often prevents costly post-event
remediation.

15 2026 ,Jan

#### Neglected management costs of household elevators

Even when household elevators are properly installed, usage-phase mismanagement and low-cost
maintenance decisions can gradually amplify hidden risks. Treating elevators as long-term assets
through systematic management and clear responsibility is key to maintaining safety and controlling
lifecycle costs.

08 2026 ,Jan

#### Elevator Management Decisions Affect Business Profits

Elevators are not just transportation tools but an integral part of the operational chain, and
engaging professional suppliers early can effectively reduce post-construction cost risks while
improving efficiency and customer satisfaction.

#### Peak Passenger Flow Miscalculation Triggers Operational Risks

Elevator congestion in commercial complexes is often caused by deviations in passenger flow
forecasting and rigid dispatching strategies rather than equipment limitations. By shifting from
single-machine thinking to system management with dynamic scheduling and data monitoring, projects
can effectively balance peak pressure and improve operational efficiency.

04 2026 ,Mar

#### Optimization Strategies for Stage Raising Equipment Safety Management

Integrating stage elevators into the overall stage system and implementing systematic safety
management can significantly reduce accident risks and optimize performance operations. For theaters
planning or using lifting equipment, evaluating operation and maintenance at the system level is
essential to ensure safety and reliability.

25 2026 ,Feb

#### The Real Test Of Elevator System Safety Boundaries

When intelligent elevator systems fail, the real test lies in their safety boundaries and emergency
capability rather than operational efficiency. Prioritizing safety-first architecture with local
control and mechanical backups is essential for maintaining stability in extreme scenarios.

06 2026 ,Feb

#### Hidden Risks And Consequences In The Elevator Acceptance Phase

Elevator acceptance should be treated as a pre-operational system evaluation rather than a
procedural checkpoint, and combining professional assessment with simulated usage scenarios can
reduce operational risks and ensure smooth long-term operation.

30 2026 ,Jan

#### Hidden Risks In The Design Decision-making Of Household Elevators

As highlighted in the previous discussion, many post-installation issues of household elevators
originate from early-stage selection and design decisions rather than equipment defects. Returning
to system-level planning and lifecycle evaluation is essential to ensure real suitability for
long-term residential use.

22 2026 ,Jan

#### Freight Elevators As System Nodes In Logistics Parks

Freight elevators should be considered as critical nodes in logistics operations, and by
incorporating them into system-level planning and dynamic management, overall turnover efficiency
can be significantly improved. Effective system optimization often prevents costly post-event
remediation.

15 2026 ,Jan

#### Neglected management costs of household elevators

Even when household elevators are properly installed, usage-phase mismanagement and low-cost
maintenance decisions can gradually amplify hidden risks. Treating elevators as long-term assets
through systematic management and clear responsibility is key to maintaining safety and controlling
lifecycle costs.

08 2026 ,Jan

#### Elevator Management Decisions Affect Business Profits

Elevators are not just transportation tools but an integral part of the operational chain, and
engaging professional suppliers early can effectively reduce post-construction cost risks while
improving efficiency and customer satisfaction.

[ About IFE ][161]

Founded in 1998, IFE Elevators CO., LTD. is an outstanding enterprise specializing in elevators and
escalators with large scope inclusive of research, design, production, installation and after sale
services. IFE was awarded Class A certificates of special equipment of manufacture, installation,
modernization and maintenance issued by State Administration of Quality Inspection. IFE was formally
listed in Shenzhen Stock Exchange with stock code 002744 in March 2017. Since 2013, IFE has thrived
rapidly with the average double-digit growth per year and the production capability has increased to
15000 units annually. 



Being the core elevator supplier of Singapore Housing & Development Board (HDB), IFE has
continuously been providing HDB and Land Transportation Authority (LTA) of Singapore with over 6,000
units of elevators and escalators, as well as premium products and efficient services. As an effect
of superior performance, IFE products have been widely spread to more than 30 countries and regions,
such as Southeast Asia, Europe, Middle East, South America and Africa etc. IFE has been the No.1
elevator exporter among Chinese brands for the last 6 consecutive years.

[ About IFE ][161]

Founded in 1998, IFE Elevators CO., LTD. is an outstanding enterprise specializing in elevators and
escalators with large scope inclusive of research, design, production, installation and after sale
services. IFE was awarded Class A certificates of special equipment of manufacture, installation,
modernization and maintenance issued by State Administration of Quality Inspection. IFE was formally
listed in Shenzhen Stock Exchange with stock code 002744 in March 2017. Since 2013, IFE has thrived
rapidly with the average double-digit growth per year and the production capability has increased to
15000 units annually. 



Being the core elevator supplier of Singapore Housing & Development Board (HDB), IFE has
continuously been providing HDB and Land Transportation Authority (LTA) of Singapore with over 6,000
units of elevators and escalators, as well as premium products and efficient services. As an effect
of superior performance, IFE products have been widely spread to more than 30 countries and regions,
such as Southeast Asia, Europe, Middle East, South America and Africa etc. IFE has been the No.1
elevator exporter among Chinese brands for the last 6 consecutive years.

# Kite Metric: The leading Software development company for Web and Mobile App Development services

## Turn your ideas into reality with our expert Software Development services

[Schedule a Free Consultation][9]

WHAT WE DO

From design to product development

Our technology stacks: Nodejs, Java, Python, Javascript, ReactJS, VueJS, Docker, Kubernetes, native
(iOS, Android, Windows) / cross-platform (React Native) mobile app development.

Machine learning stacks: Deep learning frameworks (Tensorflow, PyTorch, Caffe2), fundamental machine
learning algorithms, object detection, recognition, tracking, video, and image processing.

##### Mobile App Development services

We design and build user-friendly and engaging mobile apps to achieve your business goals.

##### Web App Development services

We develop custom web applications that streamline your operations and enhance user experience.

##### Machine Learning

Build AI applications to automate manual operations, improve business with data-driven intelligence.

##### Technology Consulting

Help shaping your idea, identifying technical barriers, suggesting proper tech stacks and solutions.

Build with KiteMetric

We help startups and enterprises accelerate their product development to bring it to the market at
the fastest speed with the highest quality. Partner with us to bring your wonderful business ideas
to life.

[Get a free estimate][10]
[][11][][12][][13][][14]

HOW WE WORK

WE PURSUE A HIGH ENGINEERING STANDARD

Agile & Lean

We iterate quickly in one-week sprint to help customers deliver product MVP for market validation
with the least effort. We take the pride for our work and actively contribute our ideas to help
sharpening the business logics.

Transparency

We invest into productivity tools for planning and keeping track of the work progress (JIRA,
Trello), well-document our process (Confluence, Basecamp), and daily communication (Slack).

Quality

We have one of the best teams with more than 10 years of experience in the industry. Our talent
engineers are highly selected through a silicon-valley-standard interview process and well trained
by the top engineers in the United States. We employ the industry standard engineering process: TDD,
pair programming, CI/CD to deliver the products at the highest quality.

Security & Privacy

We implement high security standards to guarantee our customer data being well-protected. During the
process, we frequently inspect the products for potential security issues. At the same time, our
customer NDA terms are always well-respected.

OUR WORK

# Kite Metric: The leading Software development company for Web and Mobile App Development services

## Turn your ideas into reality with our expert Software Development services

[Schedule a Free Consultation][9]

WHAT WE DO

From design to product development

Our technology stacks: Nodejs, Java, Python, Javascript, ReactJS, VueJS, Docker, Kubernetes, native
(iOS, Android, Windows) / cross-platform (React Native) mobile app development.

Machine learning stacks: Deep learning frameworks (Tensorflow, PyTorch, Caffe2), fundamental machine
learning algorithms, object detection, recognition, tracking, video, and image processing.

##### Mobile App Development services

We design and build user-friendly and engaging mobile apps to achieve your business goals.

##### Web App Development services

We develop custom web applications that streamline your operations and enhance user experience.

##### Machine Learning

Build AI applications to automate manual operations, improve business with data-driven intelligence.

##### Technology Consulting

Help shaping your idea, identifying technical barriers, suggesting proper tech stacks and solutions.

Build with KiteMetric

We help startups and enterprises accelerate their product development to bring it to the market at
the fastest speed with the highest quality. Partner with us to bring your wonderful business ideas
to life.

[Get a free estimate][10]
[][11][][12][][13][][14]

HOW WE WORK

WE PURSUE A HIGH ENGINEERING STANDARD

Agile & Lean

We iterate quickly in one-week sprint to help customers deliver product MVP for market validation
with the least effort. We take the pride for our work and actively contribute our ideas to help
sharpening the business logics.

Transparency

We invest into productivity tools for planning and keeping track of the work progress (JIRA,
Trello), well-document our process (Confluence, Basecamp), and daily communication (Slack).

Quality

We have one of the best teams with more than 10 years of experience in the industry. Our talent
engineers are highly selected through a silicon-valley-standard interview process and well trained
by the top engineers in the United States. We employ the industry standard engineering process: TDD,
pair programming, CI/CD to deliver the products at the highest quality.

Security & Privacy

We implement high security standards to guarantee our customer data being well-protected. During the
process, we frequently inspect the products for potential security issues. At the same time, our
customer NDA terms are always well-respected.

Defined by the phrase, Quality in Motion^{®}, [Mitsubishi Electric][14] sets the world’s highest
standards in [elevator][15] and [escalator][16] innovation, efficiency, safety and comfort. Widely
recognized as the leader in quality, Mitsubishi Electric has been serving the vertical
transportation needs of buildings of all types and sizes in the United States since 1985.

## MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC Elevators & Escalators Products and Services

### [Elevators][17]

[[Elevators]][18]

Designed for maximum life cycle, [Machine-Room-Less][19], and [Conventional Gearless][20]
(High-Speed Traction) elevators are available for every application, in Passenger, Service or
Freight configurations.

[New Construction RFP][21]

### [Escalators][22]

[[Escalators]][23]

Whether installing [spiral escalators][24] for indoor use or conventional [linear (straight)
escalators][25] for indoor or outdoor use, Mitsubishi Electric offers aesthetically pleasing
products designed to last the life of your building.

[New Construction RFP][26]

### [Modernization][27]

[[Modernization]][28]

Mitsubishi Electric provides a range of [modernization][29] solutions designed to enhance system
performance, increase energy efficiency, improve transportation quality, and reduce operational
expenses.

[Can my elevator be modernized?][30]

### [Maintenance/Repair][31]

[[Maintenance/Repair]][32]

Nobody plans for their equipment to stop working — which is why our service technicians take a
proactive approach to minimizing downtime with a detailed [elevator preventative maintenance
program][33].

[Get a maintenance quote (we service most manufacturers)][34]

# Novomet artificial lift services

## Lifting the fluids that power the world

The path forward for responsible oil and gas production is to always look for new ways to reduce the
cost required to find, tap, and produce a barrel of oil or a cubic meter of gas. Most oilfield
services companies are heavily focused on exploration and drilling.

By contrast, Novomet is hyper-focused on completions and artificial lift. More specifically, Novomet
is a leader among oilfield service companies with superior technologies that produce higher volumes
of hydrocarbons while helping lower the overall cost of production.

The goal is to continuously make more oil and gas with less effort, cost, and environmental impact.
The next great breakthroughs in the oil and gas industry will not come from new exploration,
drilling, pipeline, or refining technology. Rather, they will come from advances in our ability to
economically produce more hydrocarbons from the wells we are already drilling. They will come from
artificial lift technologies.

Our purpose is simple and straight-forward:
**We lift the fluids that power the world.**

Our mission is to harvest what other oilfield service companies leave behind, reduce the power and
cost required to produce hydrocarbons, and develop viable green energy solutions.

Common Questions

## Technical Questions
## Answered

Our engineering team addresses the most common questions from project managers, specifiers, and
building owners.

[Ask Our Engineers][15]

### What is the difference between traction and hydraulic elevators?

Traction elevators use a motor-driven sheave and steel ropes to raise and lower the cab. They are
energy-efficient, suitable for buildings above 5 floors, and available in geared or gearless
(machine-room-less) configurations. Hydraulic elevators use a fluid-driven piston and are ideal for
low-rise buildings (2–6 floors) where overhead machine room space is limited. Hydraulic systems have
lower upfront costs but higher energy consumption. Otis engineers can specify the optimal type based
on your building's height, traffic demand, and architectural constraints.

### How long does a typical commercial elevator installation take?

Installation timelines depend on building height, number of units, and local permit requirements. A
single commercial elevator in a mid-rise building (10–20 floors) typically takes 12–20 weeks from
permit approval to final inspection. High-rise installations with multiple units may require 6–18
months. Otis provides a detailed project schedule during the proposal phase, coordinating with your
construction manager to minimize impact on building operations.

### What does an Otis maintenance contract typically include?

Otis maintenance contracts — from our Essential to our Premium Service tiers — include scheduled
preventive maintenance visits, lubrication, adjustments, and parts replacement for covered
components. Our Premium contracts add OtisONE remote monitoring (real-time diagnostics, 24/7
alerts), guaranteed response times (typically 2–4 hours), and a dedicated service technician
assigned to your building. All contracts include compliance documentation for local inspection
requirements.

### When should I consider modernizing my elevator rather than replacing it?

Modernization is typically worth considering when your elevator is 15–25 years old, experiencing
frequent callbacks, failing to meet current energy codes, or showing outdated aesthetics that impact
tenant satisfaction. A targeted controls and drive upgrade can restore like-new performance at
30–60% of full replacement cost. Otis offers a complimentary modernization assessment that evaluates
your current equipment condition, recommends the optimal package, and calculates projected ROI
including energy savings and reduced service costs.

### Does Otis provide service for non-Otis branded elevators?

Yes. Otis service technicians are trained to maintain and repair most major brands of elevators and
escalators. When you transition a third-party unit to Otis service, our team conducts a thorough
assessment to document current condition, identify any deferred maintenance, and establish a
baseline maintenance plan. In many cases, Otis modernization components can also be retrofitted to
non-Otis units, bringing them to current safety and performance standards.

### OEM Service Contracts vs. Independent Elevator Maintenance Companies: Which is better?

**OEM Service (e.g., Otis):** Technicians trained exclusively on the manufacturer's equipment have
direct access to proprietary diagnostic tools, firmware updates, and genuine parts warehoused
locally. OEM contracts often include contractual uptime SLAs (e.g., 99.9% on Otis Premium) and
remote monitoring integration (OtisONE) that independent firms cannot replicate. The trade-off: OEM
contracts typically carry a 15–30% price premium over independent alternatives.

**Independent Maintenance Companies:** Third-party contractors can service multiple brands, which is
advantageous in mixed-brand buildings. Pricing is often more competitive, and some independent firms
have strong local response networks. The limitation is that proprietary diagnostic access and
genuine parts warranties may not be available, which can affect mean-time-to-repair on complex
faults.

**Our recommendation:** For mission-critical facilities (hospitals, airports, Class A office
towers), OEM service with remote monitoring provides the lowest total cost of downtime. For low-rise
residential or light commercial applications, a qualified independent maintainer meeting local
inspection standards may offer better value. Request maintenance cost benchmarks for your asset
class before committing.

### Are smart elevator IoT platforms like OtisONE worth the data privacy and cybersecurity
### trade-offs?

**The uptime case for IoT:** Connected monitoring systems have measurably reduced unplanned
callbacks. Buildings running OtisONE have reported an average 50% reduction in emergency service
calls compared to their pre-activation baseline. For a hospital or data center where elevator
downtime directly affects operations, that ROI is straightforward.

**The cybersecurity concern:** IoT connectivity introduces attack surface risk. Elevator control
systems connected to building networks can, if misconfigured, become entry points. This concern is
legitimate — the European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA) identified building automation
systems as an emerging critical infrastructure threat vector in its 2022 threat landscape report.
Otis addresses this through encrypted data transmission, air-gapped control logic (the elevator runs
on local firmware — cloud loss does not stop the elevator), and ISO 27001-aligned data handling.

**Verdict:** For buildings with IT/OT security governance in place, smart monitoring delivers
demonstrable operational benefits with manageable risk. Buildings with limited IT oversight should
implement OtisONE on an isolated network segment with firewall policies reviewed by a qualified
building systems integrator before activation.

Since our inception, POPL has earned a distinguished position in the elevator industry as a trusted
manufacturer, wholesaler, and service provider of a wide range of vertical transportation solutions.

Elevators, and Lifestyle Elevators, along with specialized systems such as Traction Elevators, MRL

loyal customer base.

We prioritize customer satisfaction through quality products and dependable service, earning trust
nationwide. The key strengths that make us stand out are as under:

  expertise to every project, ensuring precision and professionalism in every installation and
  service.
* Transparent and Ethical Business Practices: We believe in building long-term relationships based
  on honesty, integrity, and clear communication with our clients.
* Wide and Efficient Distribution Network: With a well-structured distribution system, we can
  deliver products and services promptly across diverse regions.
* Competitive Pricing: We offer top-quality solutions at market-friendly prices, ensuring excellent
  value without compromising on quality.
* Timely and Reliable Delivery: We understand the importance of time in every project, which is why
  we prioritize on-schedule delivery and seamless execution.

Yes, we specialize in customized lift solutions based on building structure, traffic requirements,

## Welcome to SAASA Corporation (Pvt.) Ltd. - Your Trusted Partner in Elevators, Lifts & Escalators
## Solutions

To Our Business Associates – SAASA Corporation (Pvt.) Ltd. was founded in 1981 to serve clients in
the Elevators & Escalators field. At SAASA Corporation (Pvt.) Ltd., we specialize in providing
comprehensive solutions for elevators, lifts, and escalators. With years of experience in the
industry, we are your trusted partner for installation, servicing, repairing, maintenance, and
troubleshooting of elevators and lifts. Our team of highly skilled professionals is dedicated to
delivering top-notch services and ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of your vertical
transportation systems.

### About Us

About SAASA Corporation (Pvt.) Ltd.

Welcome to SAASA Corporation (Pvt.) Ltd., a leading provider of elevator, lift, and escalator
solutions since 1981. With over four decades of industry experience, we have established ourselves
as a trusted name in the vertical transportation sector. Our commitment to excellence and customer
satisfaction has enabled us to successfully complete over 500 elevator and lift projects across
various industries.

Our Expertise and Experience

With a legacy spanning more than 40 years, SAASA Corporation brings a wealth of knowledge and
expertise to every project. Our team of highly qualified staff and engineers, consisting of more
than 50 dedicated professionals, is committed to delivering exceptional results. Their vast
experience and technical skills allow us to tackle projects of any size and complexity, ensuring
superior quality and precision in our work.

#### Our Vision

Our vision at SAASA Corporation (Pvt.) Ltd. is to be the leading provider of elevators, lifts, and
escalators solutions, recognized for our commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer
satisfaction. We strive to transform the vertical transportation industry through cutting-edge
technologies and superior service.

#### Our Mission

Our mission is to deliver exceptional elevator and lift solutions that enhance vertical mobility,
safety, and efficiency for our clients. We aim to exceed customer expectations by providing reliable
installations, prompt maintenance and repair services, and innovative troubleshooting solutions. We
are dedicated to building long-term relationships with our clients based on trust, integrity, and
exceptional service.

#### Our Values
1. Customer Focus: We prioritize our customers’ needs and strive to provide them with tailored
   solutions, exceptional service, and prompt response times. We aim to understand their unique
   requirements and deliver solutions that exceed their expectations.
2. Quality and Excellence: We are committed to delivering the highest quality of workmanship and
   service. We adhere to strict quality control measures throughout our processes, ensuring that our
   installations, maintenance, and repairs meet international standards and regulations.
3. Innovation: We embrace innovation and continuously seek new technologies and solutions to enhance
   the performance, safety, and efficiency of elevators, lifts, and escalators. We stay at the
   forefront of industry advancements to provide our clients with cutting-edge solutions.
4. Integrity: We conduct our business with honesty, transparency, and integrity. We value trust and
   strive to maintain strong relationships with our clients, partners, and employees by upholding
   the highest ethical standards.
5. Teamwork: We foster a collaborative work environment where teamwork and mutual respect are
   valued. Our qualified staff and engineers work together to deliver exceptional results,
   leveraging their expertise and skills to achieve project success.
6. Safety: Safety is paramount in our operations. We prioritize the safety of our clients,
   employees, and end-users by adhering to strict safety protocols, conducting thorough risk
   assessments, and ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

#### [Trading Division][70]

###### Saasa Corporation trading division is involved in multiple products ranging from earthmoving
###### equipment, construction materials, generators, water and gas turbines, cranes, construction
###### hoists etc. In some cases, we also provide installation and maintenance services which are
###### covered by our General Maintenance Division.

#### [Elevator Division][71]

###### At SAASA Corporation, we are driven by our vision, mission, and values, which guide us in
###### providing outstanding elevator and lift solutions. We are dedicated to exceeding customer
###### expectations, promoting innovation, upholding integrity, and ensuring the highest standards
###### of quality and safety. We offer expert installation services for elevators, lifts, and
###### escalators. Whether you need a new installation for a commercial building, residential
###### complex, or any other property, we have the expertise to handle projects of all sizes. Our
###### installation process is meticulous, ensuring that your elevator or lift is installed with
###### precision and in compliance with safety regulations.

 

#### [Maintenance Division][72]

Regular maintenance is crucial to keep your elevators and lifts operating smoothly and safely. At
SAASA Corporation, we offer comprehensive maintenance plans tailored to your specific requirements.
Our team conducts thorough inspections, performs routine servicing, and implements preventive
measures to ensure optimal performance and extend the lifespan of your equipment.

## О бренде

Корпорация SJEC была создана в 1992-ом году и является международной компанией, специализирующейся
на лифтах, эскалаторах, автомобильных подъемниках, станках с ЧПУ для обработки и штамповки металла,
а также энергосберегающих двигателях. Оборудование SJEC разделяется на 5 категорий и более 20 видов,
которые успешно продаются более чем в 100 странах мира.

Компания SJEC обладает всеми необходимыми сертификатами качества, такими как ISO9001, ISO14001 и
OHSAS18001 от DNV, и SA8000 otTUV. Вся наша продукция проходит строгий контроль качества СЕ и ЕМС.

## tk accelis signs 10-year strategic agreement with SKF to strengthen steel supply chain across
## France and the UK

tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions has signed a new 10-year long-term agreement with SKF for the
supply of steel bar products across France and the United Kingdom. Under the agreement, tk accelis
Supply Chain Solutions will manage the supply of steel bar materials supporting SKF's manufacturing
operations, delivering secure, reliable and efficient material availability through an integrated
supply chain approach.

The contract forms part of tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions' Global Control Tower offering, a
comprehensive, technology-enabled solution that combines strategic materials sourcing, supply chain
management, logistics, inventory optimization and digital visibility. Designed to help manufacturers
navigate increasingly complex global supply chains, the Global Control Tower provides end-to-end
transparency, predictive planning and proactive risk management while supporting the availability of
materials where and when customers need them.

By integrating materials supply with advanced supply chain management capabilities, tk accelis
Supply Chain Solutions will support SKF in enhancing operational resilience, improving inventory
performance and increasing supply chain efficiency across its operations in France and the UK.

François Pillavoine, Chief Sales Officer at tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions France, said:

"This long-term agreement demonstrates the trust SKF has placed in tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions
as a strategic supply chain partner. We look forward to continuing our partnership with SKF over the
next decade and supporting their long-term manufacturing ambitions."

Ivan Bourgeois, Aerospace Purchasing Manager Europe at SKF, added:

"This long-term agreement with tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions represents an important step in
supporting our continued growth across France and the UK. Having a trusted partner with deep
materials expertise and a resilient global supply network enables us to enhance operational
efficiency, improve supply continuity and respond with greater agility to evolving market demands.”

The agreement reflects the growing demand for strategic partnerships that extend beyond traditional
materials distribution, enabling manufacturers to build more agile, data-driven and resilient supply
chains capable of responding to changing market conditions.

## tk accelis awarded five-year Airbus A220 material supply contract from Dynamatic Technologies

tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions has been awarded a five-year contract by Dynamatic Technologies
Limited (DTL) in India to support the Airbus Atlantic A220 program’s all door package, which
includes the supply and manufacture of all major aircraft doors. Under the terms of the contract, tk
accelis Supply Chain Solutions will provide comprehensive supply chain management services for
Dynamatic Technologies and its network of machined parts suppliers in India.

The scope of the project includes demand forecast management, inventory management, supplier
management, and value-added processing solutions designed to enhance operational efficiency and
program performance.

The contract marks a significant milestone in the relationship between the two companies and
reinforces their shared commitment to strengthening India’s aerospace manufacturing and supply chain
ecosystem. Building on an already established partnership, the agreement further expands
collaboration efforts between the two companies, which also includes supporting production across a
range of global aerospace platforms, including Airbus, Boeing, Deutsche Aircraft, Bell and Lockheed
Martin programs.

“This contract is a testament to the trust, collaboration and shared vision that we have built with
Dynamatic Technologies over many years,” said Gopi Hanumanthappa, Managing Director at tk accelis
Supply Chain Solutions India. “Together, we are creating a more agile and digitally enabled
aerospace supply chain that will support future growth opportunities and further strengthen India’s
position as a global aerospace manufacturing hub.”

Toby Malhoutra, CEO & Managing Director at Dynamatic Technologies said: “As the aerospace sector
continues to evolve, both of our companies remain committed to investing in capabilities that drive
competitiveness, resilience and innovation. The latest contract highlights the increasing importance
of strategic partnerships in building a robust regional supply chain and supporting the continued
growth of India’s aerospace industry.”

By utilising its expertise in aerospace materials, logistics and digital supply chain solutions, tk
accelis Supply Chain Solutions will support Dynamatic Technologies with the goal of delivering
world-class manufacturing performance in India for one of the aviation industry's most successful
programmes.

supporting our continued growth across France and the UK. Having a trusted partner with deep
materials expertise and a resilient global supply network enables us to enhance operational
efficiency, improve supply continuity and respond with greater agility to evolving market demands.”

## tk accelis awarded five-year Airbus A220 material supply contract from Dynamatic Technologies

tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions has been awarded a five-year contract by Dynamatic Technologies
Limited (DTL) in India to support the Airbus Atlantic A220 program’s all door package, which
includes the supply and manufacture of all major aircraft doors. Under the terms of the contract, tk
accelis Supply Chain Solutions will provide comprehensive supply chain management services for
Dynamatic Technologies and its network of machined parts suppliers in India.

The scope of the project includes demand forecast management, inventory management, supplier
management, and value-added processing solutions designed to enhance operational efficiency and
program performance.

The contract marks a significant milestone in the relationship between the two companies and
reinforces their shared commitment to strengthening India’s aerospace manufacturing and supply chain
ecosystem. Building on an already established partnership, the agreement further expands
collaboration efforts between the two companies, which also includes supporting production across a
range of global aerospace platforms, including Airbus, Boeing, Deutsche Aircraft, Bell and Lockheed
Martin programs.

“This contract is a testament to the trust, collaboration and shared vision that we have built with
Dynamatic Technologies over many years,” said Gopi Hanumanthappa, Managing Director at tk accelis
Supply Chain Solutions India. “Together, we are creating a more agile and digitally enabled
aerospace supply chain that will support future growth opportunities and further strengthen India’s
position as a global aerospace manufacturing hub.”

Toby Malhoutra, CEO & Managing Director at Dynamatic Technologies said: “As the aerospace sector
continues to evolve, both of our companies remain committed to investing in capabilities that drive
competitiveness, resilience and innovation. The latest contract highlights the increasing importance
of strategic partnerships in building a robust regional supply chain and supporting the continued
growth of India’s aerospace industry.”

By utilising its expertise in aerospace materials, logistics and digital supply chain solutions, tk
accelis Supply Chain Solutions will support Dynamatic Technologies with the goal of delivering
world-class manufacturing performance in India for one of the aviation industry's most successful
programmes.

Certified grades, traceable mill documentation, and precision processing — available from regional
stock programs worldwide.

systems, and precision components. Available in standard grades and customer-specific dimensions.

[Request Specs & Pricing →][12]

Universal beams, columns, HSS/SHS/RHS hollow sections, angles, and channels. CE-marked structural
steel meeting EN 10025-2 S235/S275/S355 grades with full third-party inspection documentation.

[Request Specs & Pricing →][13]

304/316 austenitic, duplex 2205, nickel alloys, aluminium plate, and copper & brass strip.

as standard.

[Request Specs & Pricing →][14]

### Elevator Systems

new installations to full modernization — engineered for reliability, safety certification, and 25+
year service life.

[Request Specs & Pricing →][15]

[Request Specs & Pricing →][16]

property data — available digitally within 24 hours of order confirmation.

[Request Documentation][17]

**We improve the quality of urban life around the world through our passion for moving people.**

TK Elevator (TKE) blends safety, reliability, and innovation into precision-engineered solutions
that help our customers ensure smooth people movement. Our dedicated teams engineer, install, and
service the most comprehensive suite of mobility solutions - elevators, escalators, moving walks,
passenger boarding bridges, and home lifts - with customer and passenger care in mind. Our fresh
thinking has led to breakthrough products, digital solutions, service and adaptive modernization
programs aimed at moving accessibility beyond conventional means.

Engineering pioneer. Service at our center. We are moved by what moves the world.

Moving more than 1.5 billion people daily through cities and airports.

We value deep customer relationships in solving their unique challenges to ensure universal

Our 25,000+ technicians are trained and supplied to service multi-brand vertical transportation

[ ]
TKE launches Dynamic High‑Rise by TK Elevator
Dynamic High‑Rise by TK Elevator introduces a new, digitally native approach to high‑rise
mobility—designed to elevate uptime, flexibility and efficiency in the world’s most demanding
buildings.

Powered by embedded AI, advanced chip technology and cloud connectivity, the portfolio enables
smarter traffic management, predictive maintenance and seamless integration with building systems.
Expert support from TKE’s Dynamic High‑Rise Competence Center and dedicated high‑rise installation
teams ensures tailored solutions for even the most complex projects.

HELIX, TKE’s new digitally native high‑rise elevator, is the first platform launched under this new
strategy. AI‑enabled and cloud‑connected, HELIX is engineered to maximize uptime, availability and
energy efficiency, delivering smoother, smarter and more reliable journeys. It expands TKE’s Dynamic
High‑Rise family alongside TWIN, DOUBLE DECK and Shaft Climber—setting a new benchmark for
future‑ready building mobility.

[ MAX Automate ]
world’s first fully remote-operated hub with MAX Automate; launch of Light Assist for stairlifts
Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas Airport becomes the first major airport globally to remotely operate
Passenger Boarding Bridges (PBBs) across five terminals. MAX Automate redefines digital airport
operations by enhancing efficiency, sustainability, and safety standards.

The Light Assist solution for our stairlifts illuminates the seat, and footrest, setting a new
benchmark in home mobility by enhancing safety, comfort, and visibility, guiding users for secure
and confident stairlift operation.

[ Universal Service by TK Elevator ]
TKE LAUNCHES UNIVERSAL SERVICE
Universal Service by TK Elevator, an industry-leading support platform, brings flexible (any brand)
and comprehensive elevator service coverage with prompt assistance anywhere in the world.
[ [ AGILE Destination Controls terminal ] ][195]
TKE UNVEILS AGILE TERMINAL DESIGN; LAUNCHES MAX HOME & EOX RENEW
Our next-gen AGILE Destination Controls terminal showcases our dedication to design and
customer-centric service with an intuitive display for maximum convenience and seamless integration
with modern building aesthetics.

Our MAX HOME cloud-based solution for predictive maintenance of stairlifts provides peace of mind
for users with real-time notifications and diagnostics that ensure maintenance is performed when
required to maximize availability.

Our flexible EOX Renew elevator brings future-proof access to older low- and mid-rise residential
buildings.

[ The new EOX eco-efficient and digitally native elevator platform ]
TKE LAUNCHES EOX; INTRODUCES APRONVISION
The new EOX eco-efficient and digitally native elevator platform contributes to energy efficiency [
E ], puts customers at the centre and goes full circle [ O ] on the needs of everyone who designs,
constructs, manages or uses a building, and digitally transforms [ X ] the everyday elevator.

ApronVision, advances fully automated and integrated Apron Operations Systems by enabling full
automation and digitalization to the apron, ensuring maximum safety and efficiency, highest
turnaround performance, integration with bridge automation technologies, and real-time data of the
apron.

[ TKE launches global smart spare parts strategy ]
TKE launches global smart spare parts strategy
A new state-of-the-art warehouse in Madrid reduces waiting times for elevator spare parts by 20% and
saves 10% of travel by service technicians. The initiative includes a sustainability plan for
recycling, emissions reduction and protection of the environment.

**We improve the quality of urban life around the world through our passion for moving people.**

TK Elevator (TKE) blends safety, reliability, and innovation into precision-engineered solutions
that help our customers ensure smooth people movement. Our dedicated teams engineer, install, and
service the most comprehensive suite of mobility solutions - elevators, escalators, moving walks,
passenger boarding bridges, and home lifts - with customer and passenger care in mind. Our fresh
thinking has led to breakthrough products, digital solutions, service and adaptive modernization
programs aimed at moving accessibility beyond conventional means.

Engineering pioneer. Service at our center. We are moved by what moves the world.

TKE launches Dynamic High‑Rise by TK Elevator
Dynamic High‑Rise by TK Elevator introduces a new, digitally native approach to high‑rise
mobility—designed to elevate uptime, flexibility and efficiency in the world’s most demanding
buildings.

Powered by embedded AI, advanced chip technology and cloud connectivity, the portfolio enables
smarter traffic management, predictive maintenance and seamless integration with building systems.
Expert support from TKE’s Dynamic High‑Rise Competence Center and dedicated high‑rise installation
teams ensures tailored solutions for even the most complex projects.

HELIX, TKE’s new digitally native high‑rise elevator, is the first platform launched under this new
strategy. AI‑enabled and cloud‑connected, HELIX is engineered to maximize uptime, availability and
energy efficiency, delivering smoother, smarter and more reliable journeys. It expands TKE’s Dynamic
High‑Rise family alongside TWIN, DOUBLE DECK and Shaft Climber—setting a new benchmark for
future‑ready building mobility.

[ MAX Automate ]
world’s first fully remote-operated hub with MAX Automate; launch of Light Assist for stairlifts
Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas Airport becomes the first major airport globally to remotely operate
Passenger Boarding Bridges (PBBs) across five terminals. MAX Automate redefines digital airport
operations by enhancing efficiency, sustainability, and safety standards.

The Light Assist solution for our stairlifts illuminates the seat, and footrest, setting a new
benchmark in home mobility by enhancing safety, comfort, and visibility, guiding users for secure
and confident stairlift operation.

[ Universal Service by TK Elevator ]
TKE LAUNCHES UNIVERSAL SERVICE
Universal Service by TK Elevator, an industry-leading support platform, brings flexible (any brand)
and comprehensive elevator service coverage with prompt assistance anywhere in the world.
[ [ AGILE Destination Controls terminal ] ][195]
TKE UNVEILS AGILE TERMINAL DESIGN; LAUNCHES MAX HOME & EOX RENEW
Our next-gen AGILE Destination Controls terminal showcases our dedication to design and
customer-centric service with an intuitive display for maximum convenience and seamless integration
with modern building aesthetics.

Our MAX HOME cloud-based solution for predictive maintenance of stairlifts provides peace of mind
for users with real-time notifications and diagnostics that ensure maintenance is performed when
required to maximize availability.

Our flexible EOX Renew elevator brings future-proof access to older low- and mid-rise residential
buildings.

[ The new EOX eco-efficient and digitally native elevator platform ]
TKE LAUNCHES EOX; INTRODUCES APRONVISION
The new EOX eco-efficient and digitally native elevator platform contributes to energy efficiency [
E ], puts customers at the centre and goes full circle [ O ] on the needs of everyone who designs,
constructs, manages or uses a building, and digitally transforms [ X ] the everyday elevator.

ApronVision, advances fully automated and integrated Apron Operations Systems by enabling full
automation and digitalization to the apron, ensuring maximum safety and efficiency, highest
turnaround performance, integration with bridge automation technologies, and real-time data of the
apron.

[ TKE launches global smart spare parts strategy ]
TKE launches global smart spare parts strategy
A new state-of-the-art warehouse in Madrid reduces waiting times for elevator spare parts by 20% and
saves 10% of travel by service technicians. The initiative includes a sustainability plan for
recycling, emissions reduction and protection of the environment.

[Get Extension][1]

# There was a Dream

Dear reader, it is safe to assume that you use Wikipedia. And you use it repeatedly. It helps you
answer many very important questions. It is possible due to the fact that, at the moment, Wikipedia
is the largest and most relevant encyclopedia created by humankind. Also, it is the fastest source
to get any information. And it's perfectly true.

But, there's a problem. There is the obstacle which has been interfering with users and us, the
creators of WIKI 2, for over a decade now. Wikipedia offers great content, but it is also looks very
old-fashioned in terms of its appearance. Its interface is not always user-friendly, there are
serious problems with readability, and a real disaster when it comes to aesthetics. And, judging by
the progress, it's going to stay this way either for a long time or for good.

We suffered and dreamed. We waited for a long time. And when we grew tired of waiting, we decided to
fix it all ourselves. We’ve brought together the best of the best and we worked hard. Thus, we have
created WIKI 2 which is the magic mirror which reflects Wikipedia and turns it into a beautiful
princess. The one, it deserves to be.

Moreover, we've created not just one, but several of such mirrors in order to ensure that you can
choose the one that fits you the best. And we named them The Atmospheres. Take a look:

By the way, if you want to share your choice with a friend, just send them a link and they will see
the page exactly the way you see it (unless they didn’t choose their own Atmosphere already).

What do you think?

Imagine, you come to a bookstore looking for some encyclopedia and have two options. One has a
beautiful cover with a nice paper and professionally designed and well-readable text. The other one
has the cheapest paper, its letters are poorly printed, and its illustrations are of low-quality.
Which one will you choose? This analogy explains the essence of the differences.

## YouTube Encyclopedic

Tubie is smart. He is better than all of us when it comes to searching, but sometimes even he makes
mistakes. However, then he does his best not to repeat them ever again. Give him some time, and he
will become a flawless professor.

Why limit yourself only to the improvements when you can also create something completely new?
That’s what we said to ourselves and began building the robot that would gather reference, research,
and instructional videos from the web. We taught it for a long time, it grew up, matured, and has
become a brave scientific researcher, working 24/7. Now it is so smart that it can find an
encyclopedic video on YouTube or Google better than we do. This is possible due to the fact that it
knows a lot about Wikipedia, even more than people usually do.

We would like to talk about hundreds of new features and improvements, among which there are
articles preview, illustrations retouching, and much more, but we are confident that you'll be able
to see it all for yourself.

And remember, WIKI 2 is not a different encyclopedia, it is the same good old Wikipedia, but with a
completely new and modern look. By the way, you can always compare and switch to the old interface
by using the “Show original” link available in the top menu of the page.

## How to transfigure the Wikipedia

[
Get Extension
][2]

There are three ways to start using WIKI 2. You can type the wiki2.org address into the address bar
or make a bookmark of any converted page and use search like you would normally do.

But there is the magic trick worth mentioning separately. If you replace few characters in any URL
address of the original Wikipedia with the symbol "2", like this: wikipedia.org → wiki2.org, the
page will transform.

This stratagem is useful, but we went even further and created a helper. It can make this change in
the address by itself. The helper is a browser extension. It is absolutely free and is available on
official Google, Mozilla, or Apple extension stores. By the way, after installing it, which is
extremely simple, you will also get an opportunity to search anything on WIKI 2 via the context menu
(usually right mouse button click). On any website.

So, now you know a bit about WIKI 2. And while we are working on new, even more amazing things for
the project, we offer you, dear reader, to explore the horizons of knowledge accumulated by
Humankind:

Start exploration:

Sincerely Yours,

# There was a Dream

Dear reader, it is safe to assume that you use Wikipedia. And you use it repeatedly. It helps you
answer many very important questions. It is possible due to the fact that, at the moment, Wikipedia
is the largest and most relevant encyclopedia created by humankind. Also, it is the fastest source
to get any information. And it's perfectly true.

But, there's a problem. There is the obstacle which has been interfering with users and us, the
creators of WIKI 2, for over a decade now. Wikipedia offers great content, but it is also looks very
old-fashioned in terms of its appearance. Its interface is not always user-friendly, there are
serious problems with readability, and a real disaster when it comes to aesthetics. And, judging by
the progress, it's going to stay this way either for a long time or for good.

We suffered and dreamed. We waited for a long time. And when we grew tired of waiting, we decided to
fix it all ourselves. We’ve brought together the best of the best and we worked hard. Thus, we have
created WIKI 2 which is the magic mirror which reflects Wikipedia and turns it into a beautiful
princess. The one, it deserves to be.

Moreover, we've created not just one, but several of such mirrors in order to ensure that you can
choose the one that fits you the best. And we named them The Atmospheres. Take a look:

By the way, if you want to share your choice with a friend, just send them a link and they will see
the page exactly the way you see it (unless they didn’t choose their own Atmosphere already).

What do you think?

Imagine, you come to a bookstore looking for some encyclopedia and have two options. One has a
beautiful cover with a nice paper and professionally designed and well-readable text. The other one
has the cheapest paper, its letters are poorly printed, and its illustrations are of low-quality.
Which one will you choose? This analogy explains the essence of the differences.

## YouTube Encyclopedic

Tubie is smart. He is better than all of us when it comes to searching, but sometimes even he makes
mistakes. However, then he does his best not to repeat them ever again. Give him some time, and he
will become a flawless professor.

Why limit yourself only to the improvements when you can also create something completely new?
That’s what we said to ourselves and began building the robot that would gather reference, research,
and instructional videos from the web. We taught it for a long time, it grew up, matured, and has
become a brave scientific researcher, working 24/7. Now it is so smart that it can find an
encyclopedic video on YouTube or Google better than we do. This is possible due to the fact that it
knows a lot about Wikipedia, even more than people usually do.

We would like to talk about hundreds of new features and improvements, among which there are
articles preview, illustrations retouching, and much more, but we are confident that you'll be able
to see it all for yourself.

And remember, WIKI 2 is not a different encyclopedia, it is the same good old Wikipedia, but with a
completely new and modern look. By the way, you can always compare and switch to the old interface
by using the “Show original” link available in the top menu of the page.

## How to transfigure the Wikipedia

[
Get Extension
][2]

There are three ways to start using WIKI 2. You can type the wiki2.org address into the address bar
or make a bookmark of any converted page and use search like you would normally do.

But there is the magic trick worth mentioning separately. If you replace few characters in any URL
address of the original Wikipedia with the symbol "2", like this: wikipedia.org → wiki2.org, the
page will transform.

This stratagem is useful, but we went even further and created a helper. It can make this change in
the address by itself. The helper is a browser extension. It is absolutely free and is available on
official Google, Mozilla, or Apple extension stores. By the way, after installing it, which is
extremely simple, you will also get an opportunity to search anything on WIKI 2 via the context menu
(usually right mouse button click). On any website.

So, now you know a bit about WIKI 2. And while we are working on new, even more amazing things for
the project, we offer you, dear reader, to explore the horizons of knowledge accumulated by
Humankind:

Start exploration:

Sincerely Yours,
WIKI 2 Team

Project was started in January of 2012 with first release in April 2013.

### Vision and goals

YFZ Co. Ltd is committed to its vision focused on assisting clients in obtaining the best services
from supply, installation, to maintenance, at competitive prices. The company attracts a team of
highly qualified personnel to provide quality products, sell original spare parts, and provide
consultations and recommendations to our clients. We are keen in the company to implement and follow
up the flow of work in the fullest manner and we are committed to continuous accountability,
flexibility and perfection YFZ Co. Ltd seeks to gain a leadership role in the market by adopting
smart solutions and using the latest technologies. Through its continuous efforts, the company aims
to be one of the leading companies supplying and installing elevators in the Gulf.

][32] [

### Our story

Following international cooperation with an exclusive distribution agreement with the international
Japanese company, “AOYAMA” which was founded in 1966 and is a professional elevator manufacturer in
Japan. This global partnership provided YFZ Co. Ltd with competitive advantages in terms of
technical support and project management services. The parent company, Youssef Fouad Zuhairi
Company, was established in 2007 in Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company started as a
company specializing in the field of cars and transportation, and within a few years it was on the
throne of the largest leading companies in the car trade in the Kingdom. The company won several
international honors and awards, and expanded its reach by opening several branches throughout the
Kingdom. Given the local market’s lack of professional companies in the field of elevators and
escalators, the Board of Directors saw an ideal opportunity to expand and diversify the activities
of the Youssef Fouad Zuhairi Group and enhance its profits, in addition to creating multiple local
job opportunities. Thus, Yves Elevators and Escalators was established in 2011 as a branch of the
owner company, with the latter continuing to follow up and develop its business in the field of cars
and transportation. Today, the Youssef Fouad Zuhairi Group includes several subsidiary companies
managed by Engineer Youssef and his sons. Despite this, the group ensures that each subsidiary is
independently operated and managed in line with its day-to-day operations and development affairs.
The group, with all its subsidiaries, seeks to develop and expand its business through: ● Improving
the level of services. ● Product diversification. ● Increasing and enhancing marketing activities
throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
